items.followUp: State the commutative laws of Boolean algebra for OR and AND.

rubric.why: The OR identity shows that changing the grouping does not change the result.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct OR identity.

rubric.why: The AND identity shows that changing the grouping does not change the result.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct AND identity.

modelAnswer: Associative law for OR: (A + B) + C = A + (B + C).
Associative law for AND: (A · B) · C = A · (B · C).

rubric.why: Identifies the copying or installation of licensed software.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the copying or installation of licensed software.

rubric.why: Identifies that the software is used on more computers than the licence allows.
rubric.description: Use on more computers than the licence permits
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that use exceeds the licence's permitted number of computers.

modelAnswer: Soft lifting is copying or installing licensed software on more computers than the licence permits.
It is unauthorized use of software and is a form of software piracy.

items.followUp: What is file sharing on a computer network?

rubric.why: States that an application is shared over a network.
rubric.description: Sharing an application over a network
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying application sharing as sharing an application over a network.

rubric.why: Explains that multiple users can access or use the same application.
rubric.description: Users access or use the same application
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that users can access or use the shared application.

modelAnswer: Application sharing allows users on a network to access and use the same application.
The application can be used from different computers without installing a separate copy on each one.

items.followUp: State two disadvantages of star topology.

rubric.why: Identifies that the failure of one attached device does not disrupt the others.
rubric.description: Failure of one device does not affect the other devices
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating this advantage.

rubric.why: Identifies an advantage of easy expansion or fault detection.
rubric.description: Devices are easy to add or remove, or faults are easier to locate

modelAnswer: Failure of one node or device does not affect the other devices on the network.
It is easy to add or remove devices, and faults are easier to locate.
